# Photo Filters

Photo filters: turn a photo from your MegaScenes library into a new look, such as cartoon, anime, watercolor, oil painting, pencil sketch, pop art or vintage film, keeping its composition.

## What it does
Pick a photo from your MegaScenes library and the look you want. Claude tells you the price and restyles the whole photo, keeping its composition and the people recognizable.

**How the files are made:** each filtered photo is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

For your own photos or ones whose people agreed.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install photo-filters@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Photo Filters talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/photo-filter/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each filtered photo uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The filtered photos show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_filtered_photo_models` | Models for filtered photos with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_filtered_photo_cost` | Exact price of one filtered photo before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_filtered_photo` | Starts one filtered photo in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_filtered_photo` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Turn my latest MegaScenes photo into a watercolor painting"
- "Make my last photo look like a pencil sketch"
- "Give my portrait photo a soft hand-painted anime look"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the filtered photo (the photo you pick from your library and the style you choose) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
